title: Evaluating and comparing gender bias across four text-to-image models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating 50 images for 30 different professions using four text-to-image models (DALL-E 3, Emu, Stable Diffusion XL, and Stable Cascade), manually classifying the gender (male or female) of the depicted individuals, and applying binomial distribution tests to detect significant deviations from a 1:1 (50:50) gender ratio.
